name: scRNA-seq protocol benchmarking for cell atlas projects
description: Compares single-cell RNA-sequencing protocols to inform choices for large-scale cell atlas projects by evaluating sensitivity, cost, and cell-type detection.
reputation: Well-regarded within the single-cell genomics community as a practical reference for choosing protocols for large-scale cell atlas projects.
notes: Results are protocol- and sample-dependent; affected by batch effects, contamination risk, library saturation, and cost trade-offs — limited direct comparability across different labs and sample types.
